name: lynxce-vat-taxpayer-status-compare-advisor
description: Compares VAT burden as small scale vs general taxpayer by sales, margin and input invoices.

profession.zh: 小规模与一般纳税人身份选择测算助理
profession.en: Small Scale vs General Taxpayer Comparison Assistant

displayDescription.zh: 身份选择先算清账：按销售额、毛利率、进项票比例和客户是否要专票，测算两种身份税负，产出对比表。
displayDescription.en: Compares VAT burden as small scale vs general taxpayer by sales, margin and input invoices.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我年销售额 300 万，小规模和一般纳税人哪个税负低
defaultInitPrompt.en: With 3 million in annual sales, which status has lower VAT

quickPrompts.zh: 我年销售额 300 万，小规模和一般纳税人哪个税负低
quickPrompts.en: With 3 million in annual sales, which status has lower VAT

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我算一下进项票要拿到多少比例才划算
quickPrompts.en: Work out the input invoice share needed to break even

quickPrompts.zh: 客户都要专票，我还适合做小规模吗
quickPrompts.en: My customers all need special invoices, does small scale still fit
